project_name.justification: The company can earn a 100% interest in the Dort project (the "Project") located in the Omineca Mining Division, central British Columbia...

company_name.value: Pegmatite One Lithium and Gold Corp.
company_name.justification: Pegmatite One Lithium and Gold Corp. (CSE: PGA) ("Pegmatite One" or the "Company") is pleased to announce it has entered into an arm's length option agreement...

ceo_buyer.justification: "We are delighted to announce the option of the Dort Property, which represents a promising addition to our portfolio," said Kelly Abbott, CEO of Pegmatite One.

interest_acquired_percent.justification: ...the Company can earn a 100% interest in the Dort project...

primary_commodity.justification: Pegmatite One Options Dort Gold Property in Central British Columbia

verified_article_link.justification: The article is titled 'Pegmatite One Options Dort Gold Property in Central British Columbia' and describes the option agreement for the Dort project, which matches the project of interest.

currency.justification: The buyer, Pegmatite One Lithium and Gold Corp., is listed on the Canadian Securities Exchange (CSE), and payments are denoted with '$'. This implies the currency is Canadian Dollars (CAD). Quote: '...the Canadian Securities Exchange (the "Exchange")...'

cash_payments_raw.justification: The agreement specifies payments in shares. While the company has the option to pay cash in lieu of shares, the primary consideration is shares, not cash. No mandatory cash payments are listed.

share_payments_raw.justification: The total value of share payments is $75,000, calculated from the sum of three tranches: "(i) $5,000 in Shares on or before the 10th day following the signing of the Option Agreement, (ii) $45,000 in Shares on or before April 18, 2025; and (iii) $25,000 worth of Shares prior to the commencement of any form of a drill program on the Property."

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The consideration is broken down into specific share payment tranches, not a single combined value.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The number of shares to be issued is not a fixed amount but is dependent on the volume-weighted average trading price (VWAP) at the time of each issuance.

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: The agreement terms do not mention any share warrants as part of the consideration.

option_payments_raw.justification: The agreement terms do not mention any stock options as part of the consideration.

issued_share_price.justification: The share price is not a fixed value but will be determined by the "volume-weighted average trading price of the Shares on the Canadian Securities Exchange (the "Exchange") for the 30 trading days ending five trading days prior to the issuance of such Shares ("VWAP")."

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The text does not specify any exploration commitment in terms of drilling meters.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The agreement terms do not include a specific monetary commitment for exploration.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: The seller retains a royalty as part of the transaction terms: "Upon commencement of commercial production, Pegmatite One shall pay to Kreft the 2.5% royalty."

resource_size.justification: The article mentions historical exploration results and gold occurrences but does not state a quantified mineral resource estimate with mass or volume units (e.g., tonnes, ounces).

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The buyer is identified in the text as "Pegmatite One Lithium and Gold Corp. (CSE: PGA)".
